# Gaurav Mishra - Developer Portfolio

> Computer Science Engineer & Software Developer specializing in responsive, accessible, and modern production-ready software.

## Projects

- [Estrip - AI Travel Platform](https://github.com/Gaurav18071/Estrip): Modern travel and tourism platform featuring AI recommendations, weather forecasts, currency converter, and trip planning.
- [Golf Charity Platform](https://golf-platform-gn.vercel.app): Full-stack charity and tournament web platform with Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Supabase, Prisma, PostgreSQL/Neon, and Razorpay. (GitHub: https://github.com/Gaurav18071)
- [NeuroQuiz](https://neuroquiz-g.vercel.app/): Modern interactive quiz platform with HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript (ES6), Vite, GSAP, and LocalStorage. (GitHub: https://github.com/Gaurav18071/NeuroQuiz)
- [Flapboard Typing Platform](https://typing-master-pied.vercel.app/): Full-stack AI-powered adaptive typing practice platform built with Next.js, TypeScript, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, and REST APIs. (GitHub: https://github.com/Gaurav18071/typingMaster)
